messages:
emma_support: FYI an enterprise customer (AcmeHealth) just opened an urgent ticket: intermittent 503s + auth errors during high QPS window. They said this started ~18:40 UTC and they see billing spikes on top of failures. attaching logs they provided.
jordan_oncall: @emma_support can you paste the exact error they see? 503 from gateway or upstream? any request ids?
emma_support: gateway returns 503 with upstream error. request id: req_0a1b2c3d. They also reported some requests returning 401 intermittently around same time — not sure if related.
li_eng_infra: grabbing infra logs for req_0a1b2c3d now. seeing upstream runner restart loop around 18:41:02. Host: gpu-runner-13. Crash reason shows segfault followed by CUDA OOM logs.
sam_sre: :thinking_face: segfault + OOM together is odd. can we get container logs + last 2 minutes of dmesg from that host?
li_eng_infra: pasted snippet below:
```
[18:41:01] infer-runner[pid=21456]: Unhandled SIGSEGV at 0x7f8c3b2a
[18:41:01] infer-runner: CUDA_ERROR_LAUNCH_OUT_OF_RESOURCES
[18:41:01] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 21456 (infer-runner) total-vm:...rss:...
[18:41:02] systemd: infer-runner.service: Main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL
[18:41:03] kubelet: Pod gpu-runner-13 evicted and restarted
```
nina_eng_runtime: from runtime traces it looks like a KV cache prefetch spike caused memory surge. I see a sudden 8x increase in active keyset size for that model variant during the window.
jordan_oncall: any correlation with deploys or model swaps around that time? deploy-bot?
observability-bot: No deploys recorded for that service in the 30m window prior to 18:40 UTC. Canary metrics show a sharp increase in tail latency and active memory on that host from 18:39:30.
billing-bot: Noting customer reported billing spike. Usage meter shows token count up ~6x for AcmeHealth between 18:36-18:42 UTC. Possibly retransmits/backoff causing duplicate requests.
emma_support: Customer says they retried automatically when they saw 503s. They have client-side backoff but it was aggressive. They want credit and an RCA.
sam_sre: Repro plan — can we simulate their QPS pattern? Emma, can you share a sanitized sample of request shapes (prompt sizes, model, concurrency)?
emma_support: Shared in PM: 750 concurrent streams, typical prompt token ~150, using redwood/gptx-13b-raw quantized variant. They also pass a long system prompt intermittently.
li_eng_infra: I'll repro in staging with a scaled runner pool and the same client retry behavior to see if we can reproduce KV prefetch surge.
nina_eng_runtime: Two quick mitigations: 1) add a hard mem-limit guard on KV prefetch per-model, 2) enable fallback routing to a smaller-ram variant when memory surge detected. Can push a patch to staging now.
jordan_oncall: Prioritize (1) as hotfix. If we can prevent prefetch from grabbing all keys at once, we avoid OOMs and segfault cascades. can someone prepare a rollout playbook? @nina_eng_runtime
nina_eng_runtime: Making PR with knob: MAX_PREFETCH_KEYS=500 and safe-fallback to model-x-13b-q4f. Will run canary on two pods.
sam_sre: Also add transient request de-dup token on gateway for rapid retries from same client within 2s window — reduces dup token charge and load.
li_eng_infra: Staging repro started: 700 concurrency with retry backoff 500ms x3. hitting OOM after ~2m. applying prefetch cap now.
li_eng_infra: After cap applied, worker memory stabilized, no more OOMs. canary shows requests served with slightly higher CPU but stable latency.
emma_support: Customer updated: they are still seeing occasional 401s. any thoughts?
nina_eng_runtime: 401s likely caused by the gateway returning 503 mid-auth handshake in some cases; clients interpreted as 401 on retry. We should check auth-service timeouts at that time.
li_eng_infra: pulled auth svc logs — spike in latency around 18:41 but no errors. it seems gateway forwarded a partial failure when upstream restarted mid-session.
sam_sre: Action items:
- nina: open PR for prefetch cap + fallback (hotfix) — link to PR when created
- li: roll out hotfix to hosted-prod canary groups and monitor for 30m
- jordan: draft customer comms and credit calc (include dedup mitigation and explanation)
- billing-bot: prepare provisional credit scope if confirmed server-side issue
- observability-bot: add alert rule for KV prefetch rate > 4x baseline

nina_eng_runtime: PR created: https://git.internal/r/nina/runtime/+/PR-1432 : will tag for urgent review. patch includes metrics for prefetch keys and fallback trigger.
jordan_oncall: I'll draft comms to AcmeHealth, include timeline, mitigation, and offer one week of free reserved capacity credit. Emma please review before send.
emma_support: Reviewing now, will send after jordan signs off. customer asked for repro steps; please include the staging test details.
sam_sre: Postmortem notes: root cause = unbounded KV prefetch for that model variant combined with aggressive client retry behavior causing rapid token surge; resulting in GPU memory exhaustion and segfaults which propagated 503s. Mitigations: prefetch cap, fallback routing, gateway de-dupe. Will follow up with long-term: per-tenant prefetch shaping and per-route circuit breaker.
observability-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0523. Assigned: nina_eng_runtime, li_eng_infra, jordan_oncall, sam_sre. Severity: P1 (customer-impacting).
